phase_gate: Grey cube renders on a physical iPhone AND a physical Android device from a CI-produced build

open_blockers.detail: Android SDK and Java not installed. Owner will install manually and report back; command in docs/ENVIRONMENT.md.
iOS signing certificates and provisioning profile not set up. Needs a self-hosted macOS GitHub runner; hosted runners cannot hold signing material safely.
/usr/local/bin is root-owned so Homebrew cannot symlink. Fix: sudo chown -R $(whoami) /usr/local/bin

open_decisions.detail: Nine proposed hex values in docs/ART_BIBLE.md, deliberately unlocked. Needs owner sign-off plus a colourblind check and a phone-size test render.
'Wastemarch' is a working title. Needs USPTO/EUIPO and app-store searches before any public listing.
